compositeMedicalProcedureIdentifier.description: Identifies a medical procedure by its standardized codes and applicable modifiers.

lineItemChargeAmount.description:
The local charge amount for this service line. The amount is inclusive of the provider's charge and any
applicable tax and/or postage claimed amounts reported within this line's AMT segments.

unitOrBasisForMeasurementCode.description: Code specifying the units in which a value is being expressed, or manner in which a measurement has been taken.

placeOfServiceCode.description:
Code identifying where services were, or may be, performed; the first and second positions of
the Uniform Bill Type Code for Institutional Services or the Place of Service Codes
for Professional or Denial Services.

responseCodes.description: A yes/no condition or response code.

copayStatusCode.description: Code indicating whether or not co-payment requirements were met on a line by line basis.
